messages:
kevin: quick heads-up — after last night's sampling tweak we observed ~7% higher token cost on the chat route. Logging looks like more full-trace retention on error paths. can we triage tradeoffs between sampling rate vs resilience?

maria: saw it too. traces show fallback behavior keeps full spans for retries, and our post-enrich step is marking those as HOT so retention/ingest cost spikes.

ash: +1. short thought: we currently do `sampled=true` at the agent and then post-enrich may flip it for error groups. that creates churn where some traces escape sampling. maybe we should enforce a pre-enrich sampling decision that post-enrich can only annotate but not change retention.

kevin: yep. two tradeoffs: 1) keep flexibility (post-enrich can promote to full for debugging) 2) keep predictable cost (pre-enrich immutable decision). which do we value more for prod?

tom: prod SLOs for SRE are strict; unpredictable promotions hit billing. proposal: allow promotion only if `debug_override=true` and limit promotions per minute per service. basically a rate-limited promotion gate.

maria: sounds reasonable. we should also add a cheap sketch counter emitted from agents so we can attribute promotions to services without full traces. that keeps cost attribution while avoiding full trace retention.

ash: draft config snippet for gate (pseudo):
```json
{
  "pre_enrich_sampling": 0.03,
  "promotion_gate": {
    "enabled": true,
    "per_service_qps": 0.5,
    "debug_override_flag": "env.DEBUG_TRACE_PROMOTE"
  }
}
```

kevin: nice. couple followups: who owns enforcement? infra (ingest) or agents? my preference: agents tag candidate promotions and ingest enforcer does the rate-limit check so we avoid upgrading when ingest is overwhelmed.

tom: agree — ingest enforcer has global view for fair budgeting. we can expose metrics: `trace_promotions_allowed`, `trace_promotions_denied`, and `promotions_by_service`. add SLO alert if promotions_denied > 5% over 5m.

maria: + monitoring. also need cost attribution: when promotion occurs, attach `promotion_reason` and `budget_tag` so billing pipeline can map to cost centers.

kevin: action items: (1) ash to PR agent tag for candidate promotions (2) eng-platform to implement ingest-side gate + metrics (3) billing to accept `budget_tag` and map promotions. if we hit edgecase complexity we can fallback to always-drop promotions for low-tier customers.

ash: filing quick PR today for the agent bit.

sre-bot: deploy pipeline triggered: build/ingest-enforcer v0.7 -> canary started :rocket:

kevin: thanks — will monitor cost dashboards tomorrow and loop back. :thumbsup:
